steps.message:
The runtime can return the artifact for one profile mode when the same profile
is loaded in another mode. Profile updates can also leave an old artifact in
use. Preserve deterministic serialization and normalization while ensuring
mode-specific artifacts and source revisions do not cross-contaminate.

Run the available test suite with:

    PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

steps.message: Fixed. The cache in `src/profile_runtime/cache.py` keyed artifacts only by profile name, so a `compact` artifact could be served for `verbose` loads and stale artifacts survived source updates. It now keys on `(name, mode, version)`, so each mode gets its own artifact and a version bump from `ProfileSource.replace` misses the old entry and re-normalizes. Serialization and normalization are untouched. Test suite passes.
